To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a multidisciplinary approach based on a 3D survey, reconstruction and interpretation of historical buildings can be used to support their historical and architectural interpretation and to increase their readability to the general public.
a multidisciplinary approach based on a 3D survey of an historical building can improve its historical interpretation, supporting a virtual reconstruction of its historical evolution.

a multidisciplinary approach, integrating 3D survey with historical analysis and other complementary data (thermoluminscence dating, IR images, historical analysis), can be used to increase the knowledge of an historical buildings, supporting in this way the historical interpretation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the use of a multidisciplinary approach for a better understanding of the historical evolution of a complex monument, and the consequent development of a methodology for the reconstruction of the architectural evolution of the building, based on the use of 3D survey data, historical documents, and complementary information.
the development of a methodology to support a multi-disciplinary approach to the knowledge of historical buildings.
the integration of different information and methodologies, in order to support a multidisciplinary approach in the study of complex historical monuments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed methodology is suitable to support a better comprehension of the architectural evolution of historical monuments, as well as to increase their cultural value.

a 3D reconstruction is an effective tool for a better comprehension of historical buildings, and a 3D modeling approach is a valid way to support the interpretation of the architectural evolution of the monument.
a multidisciplinary approach based on 3d survey and reconstruction is a very useful tool for historical interpretation of complex and stratified historical buildings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a multidisciplinary approach, based on a 3D survey, can be a powerful support for the historical interpretation of an architectural heritage, improving the comprehension of the historical evolution of a complex historical monument, and supporting the development of a virtual narration of the building's history, useful for a wider and more complete fruition of its heritage.

the methodology proposed is able to provide a multidisciplinary approach for historical building survey, reconstruction and interpretation, with an effective use of 3D survey techniques and 3D reconstruction models, and with a strong involvement of experts from different fields.
the 3D modeling and surveying approach is a useful tool to increase the knowledge of historical buildings, and to support the interpretation of historical evolution of these buildings.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the integration between 3D modeling and historical interpretation, supported by the use of a web portal, can provide an efficient tool to enhance the knowledge of an historical monument and its cultural and historical significance, allowing a wider and more effective fruition of the cultural and historical heritage.
a 3D reconstruction of an architectural heritage can be used not only to improve its comprehension, but also as a powerful tool to integrate and validate the historical knowledge about the building.
